 Michigan attorney general 2026 election results
 By FOX 2 Digital Staff 2026 Elections Published  November 3, 2026 5:00 PM EST Published  November 3, 2026 5:00 PM EST The Brief
 Michigan is electing a new attorney general. 
 Election results will populate below once polls close in Michigan, which is 8 p.m. local time. (Some polls are in Central time.) 
 Michigan is electing a new attorney general this election.
 Results in Michigan's Attorney General race will appear below once polls close in the state, which is 8 p.m. local time. 
 Note that some polls in Michigan are located in Central time.
